title: Logo Usage on Backgrounds
slide_intent: Choose a quiet placement area so a logo remains recognizable within richer imagery.
strategic_value: Controlled background treatment can keep T-Mobile presence visible across photography and graphics.
demonstration: Four examples pair the mark with light trails, a gradient, a clear photographic sky and an overlaid concert photograph.
practical_value: Find blank space first; add an appropriate overlay when the photograph offers insufficient separation.

ingredient.name: Logo background field
ingredient.role: Separate the mark from visual activity.
ingredient.application: Use clear areas and approved colorways; add black or white overlays to busy imagery. Approved gradient backgrounds retain 80% magenta coverage.
ingredient.scope: All brand marks shown in the guide; choose the treatment for the actual composition.
